title: Filtering the sales table by numbers · part 31

steps.title: Count rows total = 624.97
steps.prompt: COUNT(*) counts how many rows survive the filter.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT count(*) FROM sales WHERE total = 624.97;
hints: Write: SELECT count(*) FROM sales WHERE total = 624.97;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sales WHERE total = 624.97;
steps.memory_trick: count(*) + WHERE = 'how many pass?'

steps.title: Filter then sort: total = 624.97
steps.prompt:

LIMIT 3 keeps the top of that sorted list.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE total = 624.97 ORDER BY total LIMIT 3;

Write: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE total = 624.97 ORDER BY total LIMIT 3;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE total = 624.97 ORDER BY total LIMIT 3;
steps.memory_trick: WHERE trims, ORDER BY sorts, LIMIT cuts.
